scope: Post-hoc analysis of existing Advection checkpoints; no independent confirmation or SWE symmetry test.
skill: 1 - aggregate total MSE / aggregate persistence MSE; not an average of trajectory-level ratios
sampling: 30 seeds and 256 shared trajectories; 10000 crossed bootstrap draws
skill_primary: OOD 512 / horizon 16; R11 two-architecture adjusted intervals have 97.5% coverage; other intervals are descriptive 95%
history: All ten frames receive a constant shift or an analytically advecting sinusoid; one-step response uses the same deployed checkpoint.
history_primary: Mean of four signed-amplitude normalized conserving residuals per seed at OOD 512; four-arm adjusted intervals have 98.75% coverage.
last_frame: Response sensitivity only; whole-history and last-frame inputs differ in energy.
